idempotency.key_generation: No Idempotency-Key is generated because trackClaim is a read operation and the approved API contract does not require one.
idempotency.replay_handling: Repeated explicit lookups are independent reads and always render the latest customer-safe response returned by the API.
idempotency.conflict_handling: No mutation conflict protocol is introduced for this read-only slice.

cache_invalidation: Treat the tracking proof pair as sensitive input and never persist it as a durable cache key.
WEB-007 may use the immediately preceding trackClaim result in memory; explicit refresh/lookup refetches canonical customer-safe state.
testing_notes: Prove invalid tracking proof collapses to the approved 404 behavior without revealing which proof element failed.
Prove customer-safe status/timeline never renders internal audit or backoffice-only data.
Prove the web client uses REST trackClaim and never invokes the MCP tool or database directly.
